newsitem.title: USA: Tyson bought new Ferrari on day of ban.
newsitem.headline: Tyson bought new Ferrari on day of ban.

text.p: Disgraced multi-millionaire boxer Mike Tyson had plenty of money left even after his $3 million fine and ban from boxing, so he bought a Ferrari.

The former heavyweight champion was in New York on Wednesday when the Nevada State Athletic Commission fined him and revoked his boxing license for biting Evander Holyfield's ears during their June 28 world heavyweight title fight.

Wide World of Cars dealership employees in Spring Valley, New York, said on Thursday that Tyson bought the Ferrari 456 GT there on Wednesday afternoon. "He was here for about an hour. He was very friendly and signed autographs," one employee told Reuters.
Tyson's fine was only 10 percent of his total $30 million purse for the bout against champion Holyfield. The Ferrari has a retail price of between $200,000 and $250,000.
"Sometimes celebrities are difficult but in his case he was as nice as he could be," sales representative Nick Saradakis said on local radio. "There's no question he's a real gentleman."
In the fight, Tyson twice bit champion Holyfield's ears, taking off a portion of his top right ear in the third round before he was disqualified.
Tyson, 31, at first claimed he was retaliating for being cut by a head butt but he later apologised, admitted he had "snapped" and vowed to seek psychological counselling.
